name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2025-02-12.247.2): > *That so much of the standing orders be suspended as would prevent further consideration of the second reading stage of the [Electoral Legislation Amendment (Electoral Reform) Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7280) without limitation of time.* In other words, they voted to suspend the usual procedural rules in order to let another vote take place - in this case, further consideration of a bill's second reading stage (which is the stage when our senators consider the main idea of the bill).
